title: Canonical AcceptanceContract criteria body
description: OBJECTIVE: define the missing immutable CRITERIA CONTENT contract required by design section 14.2; current PlanningRunReady and ApprovalDecisionRecord persist only opaque, presently unbound criteria references. DELIVERABLE: a focused packages/core planning module and exact LF bridge/test that strictly admits a versioned AcceptanceContract with bounded criterion obligations, stable ids, node/revision applicability, verification/evidence requirements, ordering, and canonical bytes/digest. NOT IN SCOPE: daemon persistence, plan.propose/approval wiring, review CRITERION rows, spec files, NodeMission, or context readers. VERIFICATION: `pnpm --filter @moe/core test` must execute with a nonzero Test Files/Tests count. Consumer: the shared core-publication task filed after this task and the PlanRevision sibling will expose the symbol; the daemon planning-authority envelope then consumes it.
definitionOfDone: A focused production module defines a closed, versioned, deeply frozen AcceptanceContract body with at least one actual criterion obligation, stable ids, node/revision applicability, verification/evidence requirements, and deterministic ordering.

Canonical encode/decode and server-computed criteria digest reject malformed, noncanonical, unsupported-version, duplicate, over-limit, empty-obligation, and digest-mismatch inputs with exact stable code and layer.

Tests include a nonempty accepted contract and a positive-count hostile/mutation table covering every authoritative field through the production surface; references alone are never accepted as criterion content.
Every production source is <=250 physical lines, each bridge is byte-exact LF, and no daemon/store/review/spec surface is changed.
`pnpm --filter @moe/core test` exits 0 and prints nonzero Test Files and Tests counts; completion records the publication-task consumer id.
taskRails: Do not source criterion text from spec files, nodeSpecsDir, NodeMission, review fixtures, or caller-provided digests.
Keep this slice file-disjoint from the PlanRevision-record sibling; root publication belongs to their shared follow-up task.
Missing or unverifiable obligations remain UNKNOWN and never collapse to an opaque criteriaRef.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED — create `acceptance-contract-codec.test.ts` before production files and import the planned modules with NodeNext `.js` specifiers (do not create physical bridges in this task). Freeze the exact public vocabulary: version `moe-acceptance-contract/1`; node kinds `LEAF|INTEGRATION|GLOBAL_VERIFICATION|FINAL_REVIEW|COMPOSITE_COMPLETION`; evidence kinds `VERIFICATION_RECEIPT|ARTIFACT|INTEGRATION|REVIEW|APPROVAL|WITNESS`; codes `ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT_MALFORMED|VERSION_UNSUPPORTED|EMPTY_OBLIGATIONS|CRITERION_CONTENT_REQUIRED|DUPLICATE_ID|LIMIT_EXCEEDED|BYTES_INVALID|DUPLICATE_KEY|NONCANONICAL|DIGEST_MISMATCH`; and layers `ADMISSION|VERSION|LIMITS|CODEC|CANONICALIZATION|DIGEST` with the full Acceptance prefix. Define one nonempty real control draft with `contractId`, `authorRef`, exact `{graphRevisionRef, graphContentHash, nodeKind, nodeIds}` applicability, and at least one actual `{criterionId, statement, verificationRecipeRefs, evidenceRequirements:[{requirementId, kind, evidenceRef}]}` obligation. Pin server-derived `criteriaDigest`, canonical create/encode/decode round-trip, strict ordering, caller detachment, recursive freezing, and rejection of an opaque criteriaRef-only object. Build a hand-named hostile table whose exact name roster and positive count are asserted; cover missing/extra/accessor/symbol/proxy/revoked/cyclic/sparse shapes with zero getter hits, unsupported version/vocabularies, empty applicability/obligations/statement/recipe/evidence collections, duplicate or unsorted node/criterion/recipe/requirement IDs, invalid NFC/NUL/surrogate/ref/hash text, every N/N+1 local/body limit, hostile/shared/detached/bad-UTF8/bad-JSON bytes, duplicate keys, noncanonical whitespace/key order, and digest mismatch. Every failure asserts exact `{code, layer}`; empty/opaque criterion content specifically pins `CRITERION_CONTENT_REQUIRED@ADMISSION`, and empty obligations pins `EMPTY_OBLIGATIONS@LIMITS`. Add a separately hand-named production-surface mutation table over every valid draft field/nested field; each case must first create a different production digest, then old-digest encode and decode must refuse `DIGEST_MISMATCH@DIGEST`. Pin fixed version and direct digest mutations separately. Keep the test <=250 physical lines for the existing sweep, and run the focused command to demonstrate the intended missing-module RED rather than a harness failure.

implementationPlan.description: GREEN (canonical codec/digest) — implement `acceptance-contract-codec.ts` with result types and `ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT_DIGEST_DOMAIN`, `createAcceptanceContract`, `deriveAcceptanceContractDigest`, `encodeAcceptanceContract`, and `decodeAcceptanceContractBytes`. `create` accepts only an admitted digest/version-free draft, inserts the supported version, and derives `criteriaDigest` server-side. Define an explicit typed digest-source projection containing version and every authoritative field except the self-referential criteriaDigest; hash `moe-acceptance-contract-digest/1`, NUL, then recursive sorted-key/no-whitespace canonical JSON bytes with SHA-256, preserving already-admitted array order. Create/derive/encode must reject canonical output above MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES with `LIMIT_EXCEEDED@LIMITS`, so they never mint records the decoder cannot consume. Decode through the verified bare `@moe/contracts` `decodeBoundedJsonBytes`; map duplicate JSON keys to `DUPLICATE_KEY@CODEC`, body/depth/string ceilings to `LIMIT_EXCEEDED@LIMITS`, and remaining byte/UTF8/JSON/unicode/number carrier failures to `BYTES_INVALID@CODEC`; copy the proven bytes, structurally admit/rebuild first, compare derived digest before canonical full-byte equality, then return only the detached deeply frozen record. Thus a caller digest, alternate spelling, or references without criterion content gain no authority. Make the focused suite green, keep this source <=250 physical lines, and do not create `acceptance-contract-codec.js` or change any public/root/daemon/store/review/spec surface.
